reason: the authors request (2026-10-26): see the test performance of the LLM-free arms before the reader stage finishes.
change: The registered single test pass is split in two. Pass 1 (now): the frozen LLM-free arms only - PRIOR (shared parser), RULE, S seeds 0/1/2 (structural freeze b5d32f36, frozen 2026-10-26T05:31:05Z) and the supplementary Baselines-track shortcut arms TYPE_PRIOR, REL_PRIOR, ENT_REL_PRIOR and their own-parser PRIOR (baselines freeze 822a6167, frozen 05:03:47Z). M1 is decided in pass 1. Pass 2 (Phase 3): the reader, fused and control arms, scored once after their freeze; M2 and M3 decided then.

No pass-1 test number, per-question result or error analysis is passed to the LLM reader track before its freeze file exists; the reader track selects on dev only, as registered.
No LLM-free arm is retrained, re-tuned or re-frozen after pass 1.
The M3 'best arm' is still declared from cross-fitted dev Hits@1 before pass 2.
